objective_summary: Live proof of the Obsidian run-summary publication boundary: a dedicated harness fixture run (not a four-phase /work pipeline) exercising harness/orchestrator/obsidian.py through live_cli.py's publish_run_summary operation and the production filesystem VaultWriter, publishing one harmless note into a dedicated 'Harness Run Summaries' folder of the configured vault.
remaining_risks: This is a dedicated CLI demonstration of the Obsidian connector, not a live four-phase /work pipeline run.
MCP-vs-REST dual implementation remains a separate future milestone; ASSIGNMENT.md does not name Obsidian as that connector.
follow_up_actions: A live /work run that naturally reaches the Obsidian publication step remains open.
